forecast-readiness ledger v6 with Ed25519 evaluator attestation
critical_limitations: No trained XRP-specific candidate model exists.
walk_forward.py evaluates deterministic baselines only; forecast_ledger.py explicitly rejects baseline-only evaluations.

Bootstrap utility defaults are 1,000 resamples, 30 origins and 95% confidence, while readiness requires at least 10,000 resamples, 100 paired origins and Bonferroni-adjusted familywise confidence across eight comparisons (99.375% individual interval level for a 95% familywise target).

Readiness requires declared temporal and per-source cadence; walk-forward cadence inputs remain optional and otherwise fall back to median observed intervals, which are not admissible as declared cadence.
Source-clustered intervals require at least five independent publisher lineages and declared per-cluster cadence; multi-publisher target aggregates remain unclustered.
No independent shadow-outcome cohort or candidate superiority over all four baselines is established.
Ingestion workflow is not on main and has not run there; GitHub artifacts/cache are not independent WORM or trusted timestamp storage.
